data.description: Check whether the submitted email address follows a valid format.

data.label: Check CRM Duplicates
data.description: Search the CRM for an existing lead or contact matching the new submission.

data.label: Score Lead
data.description: Calculate a lead score using company size, industry, and engagement history.

data.description: Determine whether the lead score is above 80 for immediate sales routing.

data.description: Create a tailored lead summary for the assigned sales rep.

data.label: Route to Sales Rep
data.description: Assign the lead and summary to an appropriate sales representative.

data.description: Determine whether the lead score is below 40 for nurture campaign enrollment.

data.label: Add to Nurture Campaign
data.description: Enroll the lead in the nurture campaign for automated follow-up.

data.label: Flag for Manual Review
data.description: Mark the lead for sales team review when the score falls in the middle range.

data.label: Complete Lead Processing
data.description: End the workflow after the lead has been routed, nurtured, or flagged.

message: New website leads are captured, validated, checked for CRM duplication, and scored. High-scoring leads are routed to sales with a personalized summary, low-scoring leads enter nurture, and mid-range leads are flagged for manual review. Invalid or duplicate leads exit early.

workflow.workflowBrief: When a new lead comes in through the website form, validate the email format and check for duplicates in the CRM. Score the lead based on company size, industry, and engagement history. If the score is above 80, route to a sales rep with a personalized summary. If below 40, add to the nurture campaign. For scores in between, flag for manual review by the sales team.
